title: Ingestion adapters for ≥3 source types (gov open data, OSM, HSDS feed), source-neutral core
context: The ingestion layer must be extensible and license-clean. Per Hee-Lee Oss architecture rules, all source-specific logic lives in isolated adapters; the core HSDS model stays source-neutral. Each adapter must record sources[] with the correct license and shareAlike flag, store only structured facts (no verbatim copyrighted prose), and respect each source's terms/robots.txt. Depends on food-maps-schema-001 (the schema to normalize into) and food-maps-registry-003 (the cleared source list).
objective: Implement ingestion adapters for ≥3 source types — (1) government open-data portal (JSON/CSV download or API), (2) OpenStreetMap (Overpass API or pbf extract), and (3) an Open Referral HSDS feed — each as an isolated TypeScript/ESM module in adapters/. Each adapter normalizes its source to the HSDS + provenance/freshness model, populates sources[] with the correct license fields, stores structured facts only, and produces staging entries for the pipeline core.
acceptanceCriteria: ≥3 adapters implemented as isolated TypeScript/ESM modules under adapters/: one for a government open-data source, one for OSM (via Overpass API or pbf), one for an HSDS feed
All source-specific parsing logic lives in adapters/; packages/core and the HSDS model contain no source-specific code (Hee-Lee Oss architecture rule)
Each adapter populates sources[] with name, URL, license, retrievedDate, attribution string, and shareAlike flag for every entry it produces
No adapter stores verbatim copyrighted descriptions — only structured facts (name, address, hours, eligibility statements, contact)
The OSM adapter records ODbL license and shareAlike: true on all derived entries
Each adapter respects the source's terms and robots.txt; adapters for sources that forbid automated access are blocked at the registry gate
Unit tests for each adapter cover: a valid source record produces a valid staging entry; license fields are populated; PII-shaped fields are absent
Adapters pass lint, typecheck, and CI
output: adapters/ directory with ≥3 adapter modules (gov-opendata.ts, osm.ts, hsds-feed.ts) and corresponding unit tests, integrated into the pipeline core.
